notes: Human "Standard Reactor Plus" (+1 power): the Concord Mk2 housing (corner capacitors with green lamps, four feed pipes, registry stencils) with a plus-shaped core: a cross of amber light in a dark octagon, breathing over 4 frames, and a lit "+" module with a blue stripe on the north edge.
